from pathlib import Path

def split(patch_path, groups, outputs):
    lines = Path(patch_path).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    header = [l for l in lines[:4]]
    starts = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('@@')]
    bounds = list(zip(starts, starts[1:] + [len(lines)]))
    for name, idxs in groups.items():
        out = header + [l for i in idxs for l in lines[bounds[i][0]:bounds[i][1]]]
        Path(outputs[name]).write_text(''.join(out))
        print(name, outputs[name], len(out), 'lines')
